description:
BRANDED M6 X 30MM HEX BOLTS, ZINC PLATED
What it is: These are zinc-plated steel hex head bolts, 6mm in diameter and 30mm long, used for fastening.
reason: The description clearly states 'HEX BOLTS', which are specifically covered by heading 7318 for screws, bolts, nuts, and similar articles of iron or steel.
